title: Should primary schools set homework?
description: A debating club's map: a hidden premise stated as a co-premise, an objection to it, and the evidence for each side.
claim: Primary schools should set no homework

points.text: Studies find little gain from homework before age 11
Homework is only worth setting for what it adds to learning
It also builds the habit of working alone
Reading at home builds that habit without set tasks
It widens gaps between homes with and without help
Homework clubs give every child that help
